description: This Java class 'TestingUtils' provides utility methods for testing engine charts, waveforms, and related components in the rusefi project. It includes assertions, chart retrieval, and logging functionalities.

classes.name: TestingUtils
classes.description: Utility class for testing engine charts, waveforms, and related components in the rusefi project.

methods.name: assertTrue
methods.description: Asserts that a boolean condition is true, throws failure if not.

methods.name: assertCloseEnough
methods.description: Checks if a value is within an acceptable ratio of expected values.

methods.name: printRange
methods.description: Returns a string describing the expected range based on current value and ratio.

methods.name: fixAngle
methods.description: Normalizes an angle to within 0-720 degrees.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Logs failure message and throws IllegalStateException.

methods.name: assertWave
methods.description: Asserts that a waveform matches expected angles and width.

methods.name: assertWave
methods.description: Overloaded method with rise parameter to check waveform pattern.

methods.name: assertNull
methods.description: Asserts that a value is null.

methods.name: nextChart
methods.description: Retrieves the next engine chart after skipping two.

methods.name: getNextWaveChart
methods.description: Requests and retrieves the next wave chart as a string.

methods.name: getEngineChart
methods.description: Blocking method that waits for and retrieves the engine chart string.
